purpose: Model-internals-based selection decisions, not generic regulation forecast; two independently trained candidates and one withheld OCR candidate.
method: Official model cards + pinned source file inventories in R75; differentiate trained state from quantization and optional runtime acceleration; do not execute checkpoints.

decisions.model_internals: Relational row embeddings, per-table column/row attention, graph message passing and cross-sample attention; separate classifier.pt and regressor.pt trained checkpoints. Fine-tuned from TabICLv2, not generic time-series model.
decisions.comparison: Existing chronos-2 and IBM TTM R3 forecast numeric sequences, not relational primary-key/foreign-key in-context classification and regression. No functional equivalence assumed.
decisions.rights: OpenMDW-1.1 for model, TabICLv2 BSD-3-Clause attribution. Full legal review pending.
decisions.runtime: NVIDIA structured-data-models fixed source code; torch .pt weights_only loader evidence, offline cache and ABI not verified.
decisions.reason: Independent learned representation and task, two trained states; include as one asset with two essential checkpoint files, not two duplicated model entries.
unresolved: Offline-safe fixed runtime and transitive dependencies

decisions.model_internals: Diffusion-based multivariate time-series imputation and anomaly detection with curriculum and adaptive SCS/MACS thresholds; not interchangeable with time-series forecasting.
decisions.comparison: Existing IBM TTM R3 and chronos-2 forecast time-series; an anomaly detector is a distinct learned objective.
decisions.rights: Publisher model card Apache-2.0; transitive code rights unverified.
